---
title: "HMPT density estimation benchmark"
output: html_document
---

Run this file after `python -m data.preprocess.generate`. Each dataset section saves results after every replication and skips
completed results on rerun. The code prints the dataset, transform,
repetition number, start time, completion time, score, and elapsed seconds.

```{r setup}
root_candidates <- c(getwd(), file.path(getwd(), ".."))
matches <- root_candidates[file.exists(file.path(root_candidates, "methods", "baseline", "hmpt.R"))]
if (length(matches)==0L) stop("Open this notebook from the project root or notebooks folder.")
project_root <- normalizePath(matches[[1]], winslash="/")
if (!requireNamespace("reticulate", quietly=TRUE)) {
  install.packages("reticulate", repos="https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
if (!requireNamespace("SMCMP", quietly=TRUE)) {
  stop("SMCMP is not installed. Install the HMPT authors' SMCMP distribution, then rerun.")
}
library(reticulate)
source(file.path(project_root, "methods", "baseline", "hmpt.R"))
np <- import("numpy", convert=FALSE)
HMPT_MAX_RESOLUTION <- 15L
HMPT_ETA <- 0.1
HMPT_GRID_SUBINTERVALS <- 32L
HMPT_PARTICLES <- 1000L
run_configured <- function(dataset) for (method in dataset_transforms[[dataset]]) {
  run_hmpt_dataset(
    project_root, dataset, method, np,
    max_K=HMPT_MAX_RESOLUTION, eta=HMPT_ETA,
    NL=HMPT_GRID_SUBINTERVALS, particles=HMPT_PARTICLES
  )
}
```

```{r gaussian-mixture-low-d}
run_configured("gaussian_mixture_low_d")
```

```{r gaussian-mixture-high-d-sparse}
run_configured("gaussian_mixture_high_d_sparse")
```

```{r hyperrectangle-structure}
run_configured("hyperrectangle_structure")
```

```{r dry-bean}
run_configured("dry_bean")
```

```{r isolet}
run_configured("isolet")
```

```{r household-power}
run_configured("household_power")
```
